# Jenvu AI

> Institutional-grade AI trading intelligence for Gold. Jenvu is a XAU-only desk covering XAU/USD, XAU/EUR, XAU/GBP, XAU/JPY, XAU/AUD and XAU/CHF. It combines an ICT/SMC signal engine, a gold-specialist voice agent, and a live annotated chart desk to deliver A+ setups with multi-timeframe bias.

- [AI Engine](/ai-engine): How the two-stage AI pipeline scores institutional gold setups.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro ($29/mo) and Elite ($99/mo) credit-based plans.
